start:
@startuml
actor Customer
actor Member
usecase "Place Order" as UC1
usecase "Track Order" as UC2
usecase "Pay" as UC3
usecase "Cancel Order" as UC4
rectangle "Online Shop" {
  UC1
  UC3
}
Customer -- UC1
UC1 ..> UC3 : <<include>>
@enduml

target.name: Element Cancel Order — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove
Extend a relation from Cancel Order
Element Track Order — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

after.text:
@startuml
actor Customer
actor Member
usecase "Place Order" as UC1
usecase "Track Order" as UC2
usecase "Pay" as UC3
usecase "Cancel Order" as UC4
rectangle "Online Shop" {
  UC1
  UC3
}
Customer -- UC1
UC1 ..> UC3 : <<include>>

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — UC4 → UC2":
  - heading "Relation — UC4 → UC2" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Association"
    - option "Directed"
    - option "include"
    - option "extend" [selected]
    - option "Generalize"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Member"
    - option "UC1 - Place Order"
    - option "UC2 - Track Order"
    - option "UC3 - Pay"
    - option "UC4 - Cancel Order" [selected]
    - option "Online Shop"
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Member"
    - option "UC1 - Place Order"
    - option "UC2 - Track Order" [selected]
    - option "UC3 - Pay"
    - option "UC4 - Cancel Order"
    - option "Online Shop"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - text: Stereotype
  - textbox "Stereotype": <<extend>>
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
